# Amazon Interview Guide

> The whole Amazon loop: process, coding, system design, behavioral, levels, and a question bank. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Guide pages

- [The Amazon Behavioral Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/behavioral-interview.md): Amazon has no single behavioral round.
- [The Amazon Coding Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/coding-interview.md): The Amazon coding interview is one problem in a shared editor, solved in working code while the interviewer watches.
- [Common Mistakes in the Amazon Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/common-mistakes.md): The most commonly reported reason for an Amazon rejection is weak behavioral answers, not weak code.
- [A Four-Week Plan for the Amazon Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/four-week-plan.md): Four weeks at 10 to 12 hours per week is a reasonable plan for an engineer who already writes code every day.
- [The Amazon Interview Process](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/interview-process.md): The Amazon software engineer process is commonly reported to have five to seven stages over three to six weeks.
- [Amazon SDE Levels and the Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/levels.md): Amazon software development engineer (SDE) levels run from L4 to L8, and most external candidates interview for L4, L5, or L6.
- [Amazon Interview Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/question-bank.md): This page lists 52 questions of the kinds that Amazon is commonly reported to ask: 26 coding, 14 system design, and 12 behavioral.
- [Amazon Interviews by Role](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/roles.md): The loop described in this guide is the one for a software development engineer (SDE).
- [The Amazon System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-interview-guide/blob/main/system-design-interview.md): The Amazon system design interview is an open question about building a large service, discussed for 45 to 60 minutes.
